svg.title: ARMOR-SERVER architecture
svg.desc: Field nodes post their messages over MQTT or HTTP with an ingest token; ARMOR-STUDIO and the Android app call the HTTP interface with a session or a token. Inside ARMOR-SERVER the messages are checked against the contracts of ARMOR-COMMON, the person is authenticated and authorised, rules and alarms run, cameras are reached over RTSP and ONVIF, and the state and the audit trail are kept on disk. The voice service of ARMOR-VOICE-AI is asked on the loopback address.
